name: FedEx
description: Let agents track shipments, compare rates and, if you allow it, create and cancel shipments on the FedEx accounts you choose.
identity: A FedEx Developer Portal project named "{brand.microsoft.appName}", using the FedEx account numbers you enter here.

setup.title: Create a FedEx developer project
setup.body: Sign in to the FedEx Developer Portal with the FedEx user ID that manages your shipping accounts, open My Projects, and create an API project named "{brand.microsoft.appName}".

setup.title: Choose its APIs
setup.body: Select these APIs for the project:

setup.title: Add your account numbers
setup.body: Add the FedEx account numbers agents may rate and ship on to the project. You can narrow each agent to some of them here later.

setup.title: Copy the keys
setup.body: Open the project's overview and copy its API key and secret key. Test keys work only with Sandbox; production keys appear once FedEx moves the project to production.

options.label: Sandbox
options.description: FedEx's test system, with the project's test keys. Nothing is really shipped or charged.

options.label: Production
options.description: Real tracking, rates and shipments, with the project's production keys. Shipments are charged to your account.

fields.label: Account numbers
fields.help: The FedEx account numbers agents may use, separated by commas. Agents can never rate or ship on another.

capabilities.label: Track shipments
capabilities.description: Look up the status and scan history of shipments by tracking number.

capabilities.label: Get rates
capabilities.description: Quote rates and transit times on your account numbers. Nothing is shipped.

capabilities.label: Create and cancel shipments
capabilities.description: Create shipments and their labels, and cancel them. Each shipment is charged to your FedEx account unless it is cancelled.
capabilities.note: Agents with this can spend money on your FedEx account. Keep each agent to the account numbers it needs.

limits.label: Account numbers
limits.help: Leave empty to allow every account number connected here.

revoke: In the FedEx Developer Portal, open My Projects, then {brand.microsoft.appName}, and delete the project or regenerate its secret key.
